content:
Hi all,

I've been following the FLT project for a little while now. This morning I felt audacious enough to look into contributing. I see that the project board has no unclaimed tasks remaining. Wondering if there is anything at all I can do to help the project move forward and where else I might look?

Perhaps I just need to check in more frequently?

Right now the status of the project is that I'm in the process of translating the lectures I gave earlier this year from beamer into verso, and once this is done there will be a bunch of things to work on
